screenshotTooltip: Screenshot — copy to clipboard and download PNG
screenshotCopied: Screenshot copied to clipboard and downloaded
replayTooltip: Capture the last {{seconds}}s as a clip
frameCapNotice: Capped at {{max}} frames — effective FPS is lower

editor.noText: No text yet — press T to add a card
editor.shortcuts: Space play · I / O set in and out · ← → step a frame (Shift for 1s) · T add text · Del remove

transport.markIn: Set in point at the playhead (I)
transport.markOut: Set out point at the playhead (O)

text.addAt: Added at {{time}}s, where the playhead is
text.empty: No card selected. Add one, or click a block on the text track.

effects.hint: Transitions fade the whole frame, titles included — the way a cut opens and closes on a feed.

audio.uploadHint: MP3, WAV, M4A or OGG, up to {{max}} MB. Stays on your device.
audio.synthNote: These beds are generated in your browser, so they are free to use and carry no attribution.
audio.gifNote: Audio applies to the video export. GIFs are silent by definition.
audio.decodeFailed: That file could not be decoded
audio.bedFailed: The music bed could not be generated

export.fitHint: The whole view fits inside the frame; the bars leave room for a caption.
export.fillHint: Fills the frame edge to edge, cropping whatever falls outside it.
export.mp4Note: Exports as MP4 (H.264) — ready to upload to Instagram, TikTok or LinkedIn.
export.webmNote: This browser records WebM. Most social platforms want MP4 — try Chrome or Edge for that.
export.noVideoNote: This browser cannot record video. GIF and PNG still work.

background.title: Background
background.hint: Applies to screenshots and clips. Saved on this device.

studio.title: Clip Studio
studio.openTooltip: Edit clips for Reels, TikTok and LinkedIn — shots rendered from the model
studio.addShotHint: Rendered from the 3D model at the output size — not a screen recording.
studio.focusHint: Select an element in the model to add a shot that orbits around it.
studio.autoClipHint: A finished clip from the model: camera moves on the beat, captions and music, framed for the platform.
studio.autoClipReplace: This replaces the current timeline. You can undo it.
studio.needModel: Open a model to render shots from the 3D scene.
studio.firstClipNoTransition: The first clip opens the video — set an intro fade in Project instead.
studio.reframeHint: Pan and zoom over the clip — turns a wide recording into a vertical shot that follows the subject.
studio.addOverlayHint: Add an imported image or video on top of the clip.
studio.snapToBeatHint: Moves every cut onto the music's beat — the rhythm that makes a short edit feel produced.
studio.emptyHint: Render a camera shot from the model, import a video, or let Auto clip build one for you.
studio.noCodec: This browser cannot encode video. Use a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
studio.selectHint: Select a clip, text or overlay on the timeline to edit it.
studio.shortcuts: Space play · S split · Del delete · D duplicate · T text · Ctrl+Z undo
studio.safeZoneHint: Where each app draws its own buttons and caption.

director.title: Presentation director
director.hint: A finished presentation from the model itself: storeys, systems, findings and your tour, framed for the format and cut to the music.
director.name: Name
director.sectionsHint: In this order. Each one only appears if the model has something for it.

sectionHint.hero: Pull back to the whole model, with the title
sectionHint.orbit: A turn around the whole model
sectionHint.detail: Push in on the selected element
sectionHint.closing: Final turn with the call to action
sectionHint.buildup: One turn while the storeys appear bottom to top
sectionHint.ids: Each failed IDS specification, failing elements highlighted
sectionHint.bcf: Each BCF topic from its own viewpoint
sectionHint.fixed: Findings of the previous run that are gone now
sectionHint.zoomThrough: An accelerating push through the facade into a storey
sectionHint.pullOut: From a metre off a detail back to the whole building
sectionHint.endCard: The name and the URL over a drifting gradient

empty.storeys: No storeys found in this model
empty.tour: No tour yet — record or generate one
empty.ids: No failed IDS specifications — run an IDS check first
empty.bcf: No BCF topics with a viewpoint or components
empty.fixed: Nothing to compare — validate again after fixing

director.emptyGeneric: Nothing to show for this model
director.isolateHint: Hides the rest of the model during those shots. Off: highlighted in context.

multiHint.combined: One clip showing the whole federation.
multiHint.sequence: Each model on its own, then all together.
multiHint.separate: One video per model, exported and downloaded one after another.
multiHint.groups: Each project (its discipline models together) on its own, then all projects together.

director.showScoreHint: Only shown when it is 70 or more.
director.showDetailsHint: Affected elements, how to fix, BCF status — for review videos.

styleHint.classic: Eased camera moves, fades, calm titles.
styleHint.launch: Speed-ramped moves, motion blur, a punch on every cut, slammed titles, counting numbers, word-by-word labels.

sfxHint.subtle: A soft whoosh on every cut.
sfxHint.full: Whooshes, hits on titles, a riser into the ending, a boom when the building completes, ticks as words land.

lookHint.native: The model and scene as they are.
lookHint.cloud-dancer: Clay model on warm paper (Pantone 2026), editorial serif, terracotta accent.
lookHint.transformative-teal: Deep teal (WGSN 2026) with a persimmon accent — the warm/cool pair of film grading.
lookHint.plum-noir: Moody plum and warm stone, wasabi accent, letterbox and grain.
lookHint.brutalist-mono: Concrete greys, high-contrast black and white, heavy uppercase type.
lookHint.blueprint: White translucent model on navy, mono type, cyan accent.
lookHint.golden-hour: Sand model under a late-sun sky, orange/teal grade, letterbox.

studio.restyleHint: Changes the grade and the titles instantly. The 3D shots keep their paint and light — generate again to repaint them.

cover.open: Cover studio — covers, slides and posts from the model
cover.title: Cover Studio
cover.subtitle: Covers, client decks and social posts from your IFC
cover.shotsHint: The first view is the hero. Click a view to promote it; rename it to change its caption.
cover.noShots: Add a view of the model to fill the image slots.
cover.needsMore: This template shows {{count}} views — add more for variety.
cover.focusHint: Pick an element to highlight — this style colours one category and quiets the rest.
cover.stylePackHint: Capture the current view in six render styles at once
cover.conceptPlaceholder: Why this project, in two or three sentences — what a jury reads first.

lookHint.asis: The model with its own colours
lookHint.clay: Clay massing: volume and proportion, no materials
lookHint.spotlight: White model with one category in the accent colour
lookHint.xray: Context ghosted, the highlighted element solid
lookHint.noir: Cinematic high-contrast black & white with grain
lookHint.duotone: Two-tone print in the template palette

cover.explodeNone: This model has no storeys to pull apart.
cover.resolutionHint: Higher resolution gives sharp printed boards; captures take longer and use more memory.
cover.plansSampled: Captured {{count}} of {{total}} storeys, spread over the height.

recipeHint.pinterest: A 2:3 moodboard pin: the model four ways, on paper, softly graded
recipeHint.carousel: A 4:5 carousel — upload it to LinkedIn as a PDF or to Instagram as slides
recipeHint.post: One strong image: golden-hour light, a film finish and the title over it
recipeHint.story: A 9:16 story with the building framed in an arch, in warm evening light
recipeHint.client: The meeting deck: cover, project sheet, views, storey plans, numbers and thanks
recipeHint.board: An A1 board in the order a jury reads it: hero, section, plan, elevation
recipeHint.sheet: An A4 project data sheet: hero, facts table, concept and two supporting views

cover.paletteHint: Match the render, or use your own
cover.showScoreNone: No validation has run yet, so there is no score to show.
cover.showScoreLow: The score is {{score}}/100 — below 70 it starts hidden.
cover.qrNeedsSite: Add a website in the Text tab to print the code.
cover.stylesEmpty: Save your house style — template, colours, type, finish and light — and reuse it on the next project.

lightHint.morning: Soft, cool light from the east
lightHint.noon: High sun, crisp shading, blue sky
lightHint.golden: Low warm sun raking the facade
lightHint.overcast: Flat, even light that shows every material
lightHint.dusk: Deep blue sky and the last warm light

cover.lightNote: Applies to new captures. Double-click a slider to reset it.
cover.caption: Caption
cover.factsHint: Printed on project sheets, boards and the numbers slide. Nothing is estimated: what the model can’t measure isn’t shown.
cover.brandHint: Your logo, studio name and website are remembered for the next project.
cover.slidesHint: Click a slide to preview it. Hidden slides stay in the list so you can bring them back.
cover.slidesCoverOnly: You are making a single image. Switch to Deck to build a presentation or a carousel.
cover.carouselHint: Carousels upload to LinkedIn as a PDF document.
cover.shareFailed: Sharing isn’t available here — download the image instead.
cover.captionHint: Written from your fields — edit it before you post.
